Description
Introducing the exquisite and culturally rich “2025 Year of the Whit Snake – Legend of the White Goddess 5g Gold Bar.” This meticulously crafted gold bar is a part of a new series that celebrates the Lunar New Year, beginning with the auspicious 2024 Year of the Dragon. It beautifully encapsulates the legendary tales associated with each of the 12 animals in the Chinese Zodiac, with this edition focusing on the Legend of the White Snake Goddess.
This series of minted bullion bars tells the legendary stories related to the 12 animals of the Chinese Lunar Calendar.
In 2025 we tell the story of the White Snake.
After a thousand years of Taoist training, the white snake Bai Suzhen was granted the power to become a human woman. She then searched for Xu Xian to repay him for his bravery that saved her in a past life. ey soon fell in love and married. But the monk Fahai discovered her identity and convinced Xu Xian to trick his wife into revealing her true form, and he died of shock. Desperate, Bai Suzhen stole an immortal herb from Heaven and revived him. Fahai found the couple and imprisoned Bai Suzhen in a fortress pagoda where she gave birth to a son. Once grown, he freed his mother, and the family was happily reunited.
Key Features of the 2025 Year of the White Snake – Legend of the White Snake Goddess 5g Gold Bar:
Series Theme
: The bar is a part of a series that honors the Lunar Calendar’s animals, starting with the Azure Dragon for the year 2024. The 2025 Legend of the White Snake Goddess symbolizes the white snake becoming human.
Design Excellence
: The obverse of the bar showcases an intricate design featuring the twelve animals of the lunar cycle arranged in a celestial pattern around a new moon. The Azure Dragon, representing power and auspiciousness, occupies a special place in this arrangement, with its peak potency between 7 and 9 a.m., marked by Chinese characters.
Gold Purity and Weight
: This bar is made of 999.9 pure gold and weighs 5 grams, making it both a valuable and manageable investment.
Dimensions and Thickness
: The bar measures 13.1 x 22.1 mm with a thickness of 0.90 mm, combining elegance with durability.
Packaging
: Each bar is presented in a brilliant red CertiPAMP™ assay card along with an accompanying envelope, making it not only a valuable collector’s item but also an ideal gift for the Lunar New Year.
Available in 1oz, 10g 999.0 silver and 1oz, 5g 999.9 gold fractional sizes
This gold bar is not just a bullion investment; it’s a piece of art that represents rich cultural heritage and storytelling. It is an ideal choice for collectors, investors, and those who appreciate the deep symbolism of the Lunar Calendar. Whether you’re looking to diversify your investment portfolio or seeking a meaningful and auspicious gift, the “2025 Year of the White Snake – Legend of the White Snake Goddess 5g Gold Bar” is a remarkable choice.
